g.text: F169.2 the docs page's type and edges: the architecture
the menu, the code block, the page turn,
PartOf, and an h3 for a part (2)
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The page's markup comes from the framework's controls, its sizes from the docs layout's own sheet, and its corners and a step's number from the names a theme sets. The number in brackets is the step that changes the part.
